intro: The Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler is a vial containing corrupted water drawn from the elevated pools atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. Gathered by fledgling druids of the Horde, it provides the physical evidence needed by the Cenarion Circle to study a vile affliction poisoning the region's wildlife.

p: The high crags of Dreadmist Peak house natural pools whose mists historically shape weather and rainfall across the northern Barrens. When the demon-worshipping Burning Blade established their coven atop the summit, the water quickly soured. Suspecting that demonic rituals poisoned the vapors feeding the surrounding savanna, Cenarion druids dispatch initiates to capture a specimen using a specialized sampler. The foul liquid inside confirms their worst fears, reeking of corruption potent enough to sicken the herds wandering below.
